claims: The Masters cut is determined after 36 holes.
The Masters cut is determined by taking the top 50 players, including ties.
Any player at the Masters cut score or better advances to the weekend.
Players outside the top 50 miss the Masters cut.
The 10-shot rule previously allowed players within 10 strokes of the lead to qualify.
The Masters cut targets the top 50 professional and amateur golfers and ties.
The Masters cut is established at the end of Friday's round.
Friday's round in The Masters is 36 holes.
There is no additional cut after 54 holes in The Masters.
Masters professionals who miss the cut but finish 36 holes receive $15,000.
The Masters cutline was 6-over par in 2024
